title: Rory and the Silver Stream
verses:
The silver stream was cool and bright,
It glittered in the quiet night.
And Rory walked along the shore,
To hear the gentle waters pour.

Then Tilly rested by a tree,
As calm and quiet as could be.
And Benny gave a heavy sigh,
To watch the moon roll up the sky.

Now Ricky found some mossy ground,
And settled without any sound.
And Nia floated down to rest,
Beside them in a leafy nest.

And Psittaco tucked in his wings,
To listen as the cricket sings.
He snuggled close to Rory's side,
Where sleepy shadows softly glide.

A cool and gentle bedtime breeze
Was blowing softly through the trees.
Then Rory smiled and closed his eyes,
Beneath the dark and starry skies.

The stream sang low a slumber tune,
Beneath the glowing silver moon.
And all the dinos, warm and deep,
Have drifted off to cozy sleep.
